name: M3_OIS100MI_AddBatchHead
description: Create the initial batch header for a customer order. The operation stores header information in the batch order files and returns a temporary order number. This temporary number is then used when adding batch order lines and other header‑related data and when finally converting the batch into a firm customer order using Confirm. Optionally, the header can be created as “header only” without any expectation of lines. Header data such as customer, facility, order type, dates, delivery and payment terms typically default from customer and order‐type settings but can be overridden in this call.
